time_text_sources: SCW registration add-on: "Cintrifuse Annual Meeting | Oct 6 at 8:30-10:30am"
registration: Free add-on on every SCW ticket; cintrifuse.com: "If you plan on joining us for the Cintrifuse Annual Meeting, please register for StartupCincy Week."
speakers_listed: J.B. Kropp — CEO, Cintrifuse; Managing Director, Cintrifuse Capital
Guy Persaud — President of Habitat Care, P&G; Cintrifuse Board Chair
Mark Gagas — Co-Founder & COO, Sensory Robotics
Jake Rouse — Co-Founder & CEO, Braxton Brewing
text: Join us for a focused, fast-moving morning as we share how Cintrifuse is bridging the early-stage capital gap, attracting top talent and national venture investment to our region, and fueling the creation and growth of startups, jobs, and opportunity.
notes: Venue from cintrifuse.com ("Union Hall, 1311 Vine Street, Cincinnati OH 45202"). The two sources disagree on the end time (10:00 vs 10:30).
